hunterpointcapital-european-lifecare-gro.title: Vaccinatør til influenzasæsonen 2026
hunterpointcapital-european-lifecare-gro.description: Er du uddannet sygeplejerske, læge, paramediciner, medicinstuderende (minimum 8. semester) eller jordemoder og sætter du en ære i at give dine patienter en god oplevelse? Så er det måske dig, vi mangler til at vaccinere mod influenza! Hos Danske Lægers Vaccinations Service søger vi vaccinatører – en stilling for dig, der brænder for at give patienter en god oplevelse og samtidig ønsker stor fleksibilitet i din hverdag. Du har mulighed for selv at præge, hvornår og hvor du arbejder og samtidig få en meningsfuld opgave, hvor du bidrager direkte til forebyggelse og folkesundhed. Danske Lægers Vaccinations Service har travlt, og derfor søger vi lige nu vaccinatører til at arbejde med både kliniske forsøg samt influenzavaccination i hele landet. Stillingen som vaccinatør Danske Lægers Vaccinations Service bidrager hver dag til at sikre vaccination af danske borgere i hele landet. Udover vores deltagelse i kliniske forsøg i samarbejde med førende vaccinationsleverandører og projektansvarlige hospitaler, er vi også en central aktør i den årlige influenzasæson, som løber fra oktober til december. I denne periode spiller vi en vigtig rolle i at sikre, at alle borgere over 65 år får tilbudt vaccination mod både influenza og Covid-19. Vi er et stort og dedikeret team bestående af cirka 800 sundhedsfaglige vaccinatører, som alle støttes af en vaccinationsvært på hver vagt. Du er med til at sikre, at borgerne føler sig godt informeret og trygge, både før og efter vaccinationen, og bidrager dermed til en professionel og imødekommende oplevelse. Vi søger dig, der er uddannet sygeplejerske, læge, paramediciner, medicinstuderende fra 8. semester eller jordemoder har erfaring med akutbehandling er imødekommende og serviceminded trives i et travlt og givende arbejdsmiljø Vi tilbyder et job i en virksomhed i rivende udvikling der er tale om en løbende 0-timers kontrakt, hvorfor det ikke er muligt at garantere fuldtidsbeskæftigelse. Til gengæld vil der være mulighed for at deltage i varierende omfang i forskellige projekter og opgaver fordelt over året. verdens bedste bijob med fleksibilitet, høj faglig sparring og søde kollegaer! 254 kr./time (ex. feriepenge) Hvem er vi Danske Lægers Vaccinations Service blev etableret i 1998 med det erklærede mål at forbygge sygdom gennem større udbredelse af vaccinationer. I dag er selskabet Danmarks største udbyder af vaccinationer. Vi er ca. 250 læger og sygeplejersker der forestår vaccinationerne. I samarbejde med kommuner, patientforeninger og virksomheder har Danske Lægers Vaccinations Service indtil videre: Planlagt og gennemført mere end 20.000 vaccinationsarrangementer mod influenza. Vaccineret mere end 3 mio. danske borgere. Vaccineret mere end 50.000 immobile borgere i deres eget hjem. Desuden servicerer vi årligt ca. 1.200 danske virksomheder, som tilbyder deres ansatte en forebyggende vaccination mod influenza. Gennem vores landsdækkende netværk af klinikker tilbyder Danske Lægers Vaccinations Service også vaccination i forbindelse med rejse til udlandet. Vi vaccinerer årligt mere end 40.000 personer i forbindelse med rejsevaccination. Mere end 40 af Danmarks største rejsebureauer samarbejder aktivt med Danske Lægers Vaccination Service, for at sikre at alle rejsende er ordentligt beskyttet og vaccineret inden de begiver sig ud i verden. I 2007 etablerede vi os også i England, under navnet European Vaccination Group UK Ltd. I England servicerer vi offentlige og private virksomheder, ligesom vi i samarbejde med National Health Service (NHS) gennemfører en række vaccinationsarrangementer på skoler i flere kommuner. Desuden driver selskabet også en række klinikker hvor der blandt andet tilbydes rejsevaccination. Yderligere har vi aktiviteter i Holland og Sverige. Danske Lægers Vaccinations Service er en del af European LifeCare Group A/S. Spørgsmål til jobbet sendes til: personale@dlvs.dk Vil du gerne søge jobbet, så send et par linjer om hvorfor du gerne vil være Vaccinatør hos os samt dit CV

leadershipforeducationalequity-khan-acad.description: ABOUT KHAN ACADEMY Khan Academy is a fast-paced, nonprofit on a mission to provide free, world-class education for anyone, anywhere. We reach millions of students every month and are growing rapidly. We’re building a library of world-class instructional and practice resources that empowers learners. Whether they’re studying matrices, mitosis, or multivariable calculus, we want to offer students the resources to realize that they can learn anything.  ABOUT KHAN ACADEMY INDIA Khan Academy India aims to deliver a world-class user experience to learners in India that is locally relevant and is enabled by a strong on-the-ground team and operations. Our learning system is mastery-based, which allows students to master key concepts at a pace that’s right for them before moving on to more challenging content. From serving under 500,000 learners in 2016, we are now serving almost 10  million learners a month across our websites, apps and youtube channels. These learners include both independent learners accessing us at home and teacher directed learners in schools.  Our focus is to reach the underserved by making our content  accessible in local languages and by working with large public school systems. Khan Academy is already available in English, Assamese, Hindi, Hinglish, Odia, Marathi, Kannada,  Telugu and Punjabi.  ABOUT THE INDIA SCHOOLS TEAM  In line with our focus to reach the underserved, we partner with government school systems to improve student learning outcomes by enabling teachers and students to optimally utilize the tools and resources on the Khan Academy platform. From our government partnerships, we have reached 2 million learners this last year, partnering with 65,000+ schools across various states. Our goal is to expand our scale to reach over five million learners in five  years.  The Schools Team works in a lean and collaborative way with our partners, developing strong implementation plans and providing support at every step of the way. Specifically, the team supports teachers and administrators through training and resources, and enabling peer-to-peer sharing. We learn and constantly iterate by gathering feedback and through data-backed insights and efficacy studies. More details can be shared in the introduction call.  This is a 12-months contract role.  Your key responsibilities will be to:  1. Support programme implementation at the district level Support rollout and implementation of the Khan Academy programme across all assigned schools in the district Assist in conducting teacher trainings and orientations (online and offline) Ensure follow-up with schools to drive consistent and effective platform usage Track progress against defined goals and flag gaps in implementation 2. lsvp-helion:ashbyhq:056d0a90-61c6-403b-9.description: About Helion We are a fusion power company based in Everett, WA, with the mission to build the world's first fusion power plant, enabling a future with unlimited clean electricity. Our vision is a world with clean, reliable, and affordable energy for everyone. Since Helion's founding in 2013, we have raised over $1 billion from long-time investors such as Sam Altman, Mithril, and Capricorn Investment Group as well as new investors SoftBank and Lightspeed to propel us forward. Our last prototype, Trenta, completed 10,000 high-power pulses and reached plasma temperatures of 100 million degrees Celsius (9 keV). We are now operating Polaris, our next prototype on the path to the world's first fusion power plant. This is a pivotal time to join Helion. You will tackle real-world challenges with a team that prizes urgency, rigor, ownership, and a commitment to delivering hard truths – values essential to achieving what no one has before. Together, we will change the future of energy, because the world can't wait. What You Will Be Doing: You will lead the mechanical hardware design of high-performance structural systems for Helion's fusion devices. Your role will focus on solving complex, high-impact problems that influence system performance, while also growing a high-performing engineering team. You will establish technical standards, drive execution, and shape design processes to increase the speed and quality of innovation. You will report to the Senior Manager of Engineering, and this is an onsite role located at our Everett, WA office. You Will: - Grow and mentor a team of multidisciplinary structural and mechanical engineers - Oversee design of machine architecture, high-performance structural systems, shielding, and piece part + assembly design - Drive high-level architectural decisions on neutron shielding, primary structures, racking, and plant design schemes - Lead design, analysis, and manufacturing process improvements to increase throughput - Collaborate with Research, Science, Electrical, and Controls teams to derive requirements and meet program goals Required Skills: - Bachelor's degree in Engineering - 5+ years of structural/mechanical engineering experience, including 2+ years in an engineering management role - Demonstrated ability to hire and grow engineers providing impactful career development - Experience leading multidisciplinary teams with full-scope project ownership - Proven ability to manage complex engineering projects with schedule accountability - Hands-on exposure to multiple engineering disciplines such as mechanical, thermal, and large structures - Ability to apply engineering first-principles and structured problem-solving to technical challenges #LI-Onsite, #LI-KL1 Benefits Our total compensation package includes benefits, including but not limited to: • Medical, Dental, and Vision plans for employees and their families • 31 Days of PTO (21 vacation days and 10 sick days) • 10 Paid holidays, plus company-wide winter break • Up to 5% employer 401(k) match • Short term disability, long term disability, and life insurance • Paid parental leave and support (up to 16 weeks) • Annual wellness stipend Helion is an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the interview process, please let us know.

scribblevc-artificial-intelligence-under.description: ABOUT AIUC Our mission is to underwrite superintelligence https://underwriting-superintelligence.com/. We red-team, certify, and insure agents, e.g. ElevenLabs https://www.linkedin.com/posts/matiii_a-first-for-the-industry-voice-agents-built-ugcPost-7429909704266653696-d7Ac?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop&rcm=ACoAABaw0-sBnn0CU9SIZf2TfDwTKAAbDaEqsss, UiPath https://www.uipath.com/, Intercom http://intercom.com. Soon, agents will take on critical work in hospitals, banks and governments. This could create abundance - or go terribly wrong. History teaches us that standards and insurance are capitalism’s best tools for making risk legible and shaping incentives. We’ve built the gold standard for agent security & reliability, AIUC-1 https://www.aiuc-1.com/, with 100+ CISOs from the Fortune 1000 https://www.aiuc-1.com/consortium. Our team comes from Anthropic http://anthropic.com, McKinsey http://mckinsey.com, METR http://metr.org, Weights & Biases https://wandb.ai/site/, Perplexity https://www.perplexity.ai/, Thiel Fellowship https://thielfellowship.org/, etc. Nat Friedman https://nat.org/ led our $15m seed. Read more here https://open.spotify.com/episode/0FJEDsKalxJ1j4PjO7F4Cn?si=e14469cc5b1f496c, here https://whyyoushouldjoin.substack.com/p/aiuc, and here https://forrealai.substack.com/p/why-aiuc-is-one-of-the-most-agi-proof. THE ROLE Enterprises are under extreme pressure to adopt AI but they all face a security challenge - CISOs understandably worry about "how do I know this AI agent is secure, safe, and reliable?". We see this in our work daily: we now have 250+ security & risk leaders in the AIUC-1 consortium excited to shape the standard that they and others can use to answer this question. Many of these enterprises are pursuing AIUC-1 certification themselves – either for their internally built AI agents, or for agents built by vendors deployed in their environment. We’re hiring a founding enterprise lead to help us build and deepen these enterprise partnerships & drive adoption of AIUC-1. This is a novel opportunity, and in practice you will: - Lead discovery with enterprises — understanding how each enterprise assesses AI vendor risk - Work closely with our founders to shape and run experiments for the GTM approach and AIUC-1 that meets the needs of enterprise CISOs - Own and grow our portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts — from first conversation through to signed partnership - Explore deepening in specific verticals eg Financial Services, building on the core AIUC-1 to meet the regulatory and business needs of these enterprises WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR You’ll work with CISOs, General Counsels, and Chief AI Officers at Fortune 500 companies. They are senior leaders under enormous pressure to get AI adoption right. You need to be able to hold peer-like conversations with them to shape how they view this problem. You will spend as much time thinking as you will in front of executives — building hypotheses, structuring the product, tailoring the messaging. The person who thrives here has done exactly this kind of work before, just with a different brief. To be successful, we think you have: - 7-10 years of experience, likely at top consulting firm where you have led clients through complex, novel engagements - Comfort with long, ambiguous cycles requiring deep discovery, multithreading and resilience - Executive presence, and the ability to communicate a compelling narrative to senior stakeholders - Plus: 1–2+ years in a commercial, BD, or strategic accounts role OR experience as a founder COMPENSATION & PERKS - Annual salary as above - Equity is a significant part of total compensation, in addition to salary - Generous health, dental and vision insurance for you and your dependents - Visa sponsorship and relocation stipend to bring you to SF, if possible - A team dedicated to doing our lives’ best work. OUR VALUES Strong Back - High standards, keep our promise

With global licenses and T1 bank partnerships, we facilitate billions in transactions for enterprise clients like Worldpay, Deel, LianLian Global, and Rapyd. Our technology is transforming how businesses operate globally by eliminating payment delays, reducing costs, and unlocking trapped capital.  We’re a diverse team spread across EMEA, North America, and APAC, with a shared belief that stablecoins are the new infrastructure layer for financial services, and that BVNK is at the forefront of this shift. In 2025, we secured strategic investment from Visa, following our $50 million Series B with Haun Ventures, Coinbase Ventures, Scribble Ventures, DRW Venture Capital, Avenir, and Tiger Global. With the backing of these leading investors, we’re accelerating our growth – and we're looking for smart, ambitious people to help us build the future of financial services. We're incredibly honored to have made Newsweek's list of The Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces three years running (most recently in 2025) and to have been recognised by LinkedIn as one of the Top 20 Startups in the UK in 2024. Location: We offer a Hybrid/Remote working policy. Function: Engineering We’re looking for a talented Software Engineer to join our team. Our goal is to build out seamless cross-border payments involving both crypto and fiat currencies.  This role is pivotal in helping us overcome the challenges to ensure smooth trading processes together with streamlining liquidity management and automation.  Traditional methods have often resulted in customers grappling with high transaction fees, lengthy delays, and the rigidity of having to choose between fiat and crypto transactions. With our innovative solution, we aim to break down these barriers by allowing a fluid interchange between crypto and fiat currencies. This hybrid solution will empower our customers to make international payments in their preferred format, whether it be entirely in crypto, entirely in fiat, or a mix of both. By enhancing the interoperability between these two transaction modes, we aim to accelerate transaction speed, reduce associated costs, and create a more user-friendly experience.  Our product and engineering organisation is split into small autonomous squads empowered to own their problem space. You’ll be expected to form strong opinions and execute in a fast but sustainable way, advocating for the simplest solution that achieves the outcomes our customers are looking for.  Key Areas of Responsibilities: Collaborate with our product team to iterate fast and deliver results Translate from technical to non-technical with stakeholders across the business Advocate for the simplest but most effective approach in everything we do Develop future-proof products, focusing on delivering quality code consistently and efficiently. Contribute to our engineering culture and standards to help us perform better What we need from you: 5+ years  experience as a Backend Developer in a similar role, preferably in the FinTech industry. Expertise in Java and Spring Boot. Experience in building and maintaining APIs and services. Excellent problem-solving skills, able to work independently or in a team. Good understanding of financial services, particularly in banking, payments or crypto  Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Familiarity with distributed ledge

scribblevc-phia:ashbyhq:8eb5eab5-c83d-4c.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
scribblevc-phia:ashbyhq:8eb5eab5-c83d-4c.description: OVERVIEW As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer at Phia, you’ll build and scale production ML systems that power core product experiences and decision-making. You’ll work across the full ML stack, from data and modeling to deployment and iteration, on problems like ranking, personalization, and optimization. This role sits at the intersection of machine learning, product engineering, and data platforms, with ownership over systems that directly impact growth and user experience. You’ll ship models to production, run experiments at speed, and help define how machine learning is done as Phia scales. ABOUT PHIA Phia has raised $43M from Notable Capital, Khosla Ventures, and Kleiner Perkins, with backing from founders and operators like Vlad Tenev (Robinhood), Mellody Hobson (Ariel Investments), Naomi Gleit (Meta), and Mati Staniszewski (ElevenLabs), plus a roster of cultural leaders, to build the AI alignment layer for commerce. In just over a year, Phia's consumer shopping agent has surpassed 1.5 million users and partnered with 9,600+ retail brands across contemporary, resale, and luxury, representing billions in annual gross merchandise volume. We scan more than 350 million products to help shoppers find the right pieces at the best price, cutting return rates by 50%, and we're on pace for nine-figure sales growth this year. In an era where AI vertical agents are reshaping every industry, commerce is on the verge of a complete transformation. Phia is reinventing shopping from a fragmented, impersonal experience into one that feels intelligent, trusted, and built around each user's intent. This foundation of trust is our wedge to become the end-to-end shopping destination for the next generation of buyers. Phia is a lean, high-ownership team building at startup speed. If you want to ship at high velocity and solve complex problems in consumer AI and commerce, this is the place to do it. WHAT YOU OWN - Design, develop, and deploy production machine learning models that power core product experiences and decision-making systems - Own the end-to-end machine learning lifecycle, including data analysis, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring - Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data, and Operations to translate product requirements and business goals into scalable ML solutions - Develop experimentation frameworks and causal measurement strategies to evaluate model impact and inform product decisions - Build and maintain forecasting, ranking, personalization, or optimization systems operating at scale - Drive improvements to model performance, reliability, and scalability in production environments - Contribute to the ML platform and infrastructure, improving tooling for training, experimentation, and monitoring - Influence technical direction through design reviews, code reviews, and mentorship of other engineers QUALIFICATIONS - 3+ years of industry experience building and deploying machine learning systems in production - Strong proficiency in Python and experience with common ML frameworks and libraries (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, XGBoost, LightGBM, scikit-learn) - Experience owning the full ML lifecycle, from data exploration to production deployment and iteration - Experience working with large-scale, real-world datasets and noisy or incomplete data - Solid understanding of experiment design and causal inference, including A/B testing and offline evaluation - Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners and communicate technical concepts clearly - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

sequoia-enter-ai:ashbyhq:d6502cc5-e090-4.title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
sequoia-enter-ai:ashbyhq:d6502cc5-e090-4.description: Enter Nossa missão é tornar o Brasil um protagonista global em inteligência artificial. A Enter combina expertise humana e inteligência artificial para executar, em escala, trabalhos críticos e de alto volume que ainda dependem de processos manuais. Nossa plataforma permite que grandes empresas na América Latina atuem em fluxos complexos, começando pelas operações jurídicas e expandindo para todo o enterprise. Aplicamos IA para gerar defesas jurídicas personalizadas em larga escala, ajudando empresas a reduzir custos e aumentar suas taxas de êxito em litígios. Nosso time é formado pelos melhores talentos de escolas do Brasil e do mundo, como Harvard, Stanford, ITA, US0, UFMG e Unicamp. Empresas como Meta, Itaú, Mercado Livre, Latam, Airbnb, Santander, iFood e Nubank são parceiros da Enter para lidar com processos críticos de forma mais eficiente. Em apenas 2 anos de empresa, já nos tornamos o primeiro unicórnio de AI da América Latina e contamos com o apoio de grandes fundos investidores como Sequoia e Founders Fund que acreditam no mesmo futuro que acreditamos. Talent Acquisition Specialist O Talent Acquisition Specialist será responsável pelas vagas estratégicas da Enter - dos times de AI Deployment a Growth, Legal Strategy, Finance e People. Essa pessoa será responsável por construir pipeline de alta qualidade, analisar métricas com profundidade, nutrir relacionamentos de longo prazo com talentos e universidades-chave e garantir o fechamento das contratações com excelência. É uma posição estratégica, analítica e de influência, com impacto direto na qualidade do time e na velocidade de crescimento da empresa. Quais serão as suas responsabilidades? - Recrutamento end-to-end: conduzir posições, principalmente de Business, da estratégia de hunting ao aceite final. - Gestão de pipeline & métricas: analisar conversões, identificar gargalos e propor melhorias estruturais. - Construção de pools estratégicos: nutrir relacionamento de longo prazo com talentos e universidades-chave. - Eventos & topo de funil: estruturar ações de brand awareness e geração de pipelne qualificado. - Propostas e closing: entender contexto do candidato, estruturar ofertas competitivas e garantir aceite. Por que essa vaga é diferente: - Trabalhar diretamente com founders e lideranças. - Influenciar qualidade e desenho organizacional. - Ser responsável por construir áreas inteiras da empresa. - Operar em um ambiente de crescimento acelerado. O que buscamos? - Mentalidade de builder: construir, testar e iterar rapidamente, sem depender de especificações perfeitas. - Muita curiosidade: Mergulhar fundo nos dados para entender o “porquê” por trás dos números, sem se contentar com respostas superficiais. - Senso de urgência: operar com alta velocidade de execução, sem comprometer qualidade e escalabilidade, permitindo a criação de processos replicáveis para garantir o sucesso a longo prazo. - Foco no que importa: priorizar o resultado coletivo acima de reconhecimento individual. Requisitos: - Inglês avançado. - Disponibilidade para trabalho presencial em São Paulo.

somacap-etched:ashbyhq:3eb65028-9648-48f.description: About Etched Etched is building the world’s first AI inference system purpose-built for transformers - delivering over 10x higher performance and dramatically lower cost and latency than a B200. With Etched ASICs, you can build products that would be impossible with GPUs, like real-time video generation models and extremely deep & parallel chain-of-thought reasoning agents. Backed by hundreds of millions from top-tier investors and staffed by leading engineers, Etched is redefining the infrastructure layer for the fastest growing industry in history. Job Summary - Co-Develop cutting-edge software optimized across hardware and software driving the full potential of very large transformer models. - Solve challenging problems across the full stack, from low-level drivers and APIs to high-level applications and frameworks. - Contribute to the development of AI solutions that will revolutionize industries like natural language processing, chain of reasoning automation, generative media. You may be a good fit if you have - Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. - 3 years of experience in software development, and with data structures/algorithms. - 3 years of experience developing and testing software on launching products. - 3 years of experience with firmware design, implementation, and troubleshooting. - 3 years of experience with embedded architectures, IO technologies (I2C, SPI, PCIe, DRAM etc.), as well as concepts like scalability, fault tolerance, and consistency. Strong candidates may also have experience with (Nice-to-have qualifications) - Master’s degree Computer Science, or a related technical field. - Experience resolving customer-related issues. - Experience solving ambiguous problems. - Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Benefits - Competitive compensation packages including generous equity packages - Comprehensive insurance coverage and other top-of-market benefits - Unlimited compute budget subject to ROI justification How we’re different Etched believes in the Bitter Lesson http://www.incompleteideas.net/IncIdeas/BitterLesson.html. We think most of the progress in the AI field has come from using more FLOPs to train and run models, and the best way to get more FLOPs is to build model-specific hardware. Larger and larger training runs encourage companies to consolidate around fewer model architectures, which creates a market for single-model ASICs. We are a fully in-person team in San Jose and Taipei, and greatly value engineering skills. We do not have boundaries between engineering and research, and we expect all of our technical staff to contribute to both as needed.

yc-zip:ashbyhq:0c1b3417-9ba4-4630-8590-f.description: ABOUT ZIP Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before. The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA. Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups. We’re looking for a passionate Software Engineer, Frontend (Mid-level to Senior) to help us build beautiful, performant, and scalable user-facing experiences. In this role, you’ll take ownership of our core frontend architecture and ship features that have a direct and immediate impact on our customers. You'll collaborate closely with a highly skilled, cross-functional team that values thoughtful design, fast iteration, and clean, maintainable code. Our engineers have a high degree of autonomy and are trusted to take features from concept to production, all while contributing towards improving our frontend practices as a company. YOU WILL - Design and build highly reliable and resilient products and features. - Work closely with cross functional product and customer-facing teams to understand requirements and ship thoughtful solutions. - Write high-quality, extensible, and maintainable code. - Design and build scalable frontend applications and components. - Design and build APIs to drive existing and new features for a web-based application. QUALIFICATIONS - 3+ years of experience in modern web app development - BS or higher, in Computer Science or technical field - Proficiency in React, TypeScript, browser APIs, and performance optimization - Experience with web application and API development in production environments. At Zip, our stack includes Python, Typescript, React, and GraphQL. - Experience with industry standard build, test, deploy tools. At Zip, we work with: Kubernetes, Spinnaker, Jenkins, Segment, Github Actions, Datadog, Bugsnag and Fullstory. - Ability and interest to quickly learn new frameworks and architecture patterns as needed - Experience working at a small company with diverse responsibilities is a bonus, but not required. - Exposure to AI-driven automation or interest in working with AI/ML teams to build intelligent workflows. The salary range for this role is $150,000 - $220,000. The salary for this position is determined based on a variety of job-related factors that may include location, relevant experience, education, or particular skills and expertise.
